subject: Is there a hyperlink widget for non-HTML ui?

messages.author: 40b63348dbcb447d
messages.subject: Is there a hyperlink widget for non-HTML ui?
parts:
Hi,

I have written a bunch of stuff so do not want to rewrite the app in HTML from scratch. Is there a simple way for me to add a hyperlink? Thank you.

Ziyuan

messages.author: f806781d102fe0ab
messages.subject: Re: Is there a hyperlink widget for non-HTML ui?
parts:
You can add any HTML to the R-based UI (in fact, the R-based UI widget functions are all thin wrappers over HTML building functions).

Here's how you would write this HTML:

<a href="foo" class="bar"><strong>baz</strong></a>

In ui.R (named arguments become attributes and unnamed arguments become children):

tags$a(href="foo", class="bar",
  tags$strong(
    "baz"
  )
)

Or another way:

HTML('<a href="foo" class="bar"><strong>baz</strong></a>')

See ?tags and ?HTML for more details.
